purpose: Source register for expanding the app course catalog to a verified eight-country inventory

countries.coverage: curated national destination course list; not a complete national inventory
countries.notes: Contains selected courses across Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Tokai, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, Kyushu and Okinawa. Use as a verified discovery source; supplement with prefectural/operator directories.

countries.sourceName: Korea Golf Association member golf course directory
countries.coverage: member course directory with regional details and addresses; pagination/filter coverage needs full extraction
countries.notes: Directory page exposes course names, addresses, telephone, hole counts and province. Extract all pages/records and confirm active operation.

countries.coverage: 21 ranked/selected courses across China; not a complete national inventory
countries.notes: Use only as a curated discovery list, not a national registry. A complete mainland inventory requires further provincial/operator and golf association sources; Hong Kong/Macau scope must remain explicit.

countries.sourceName: Regional Golf Course List (Public Bank Vietnam PDF)
countries.coverage: 51 named courses grouped North/Central/South in the retrieved document; status and currency require verification
countries.notes: Use the PDF regional grouping as discovery metadata only. Map each course to one of the six configured subregions after checking city/address.

countries.sourceName: Thailand Golf Association course/slope rating list
countries.coverage: course/slope rating list; complete page extraction and regional mapping required
countries.notes: Association source lists course names and course layouts. Treat separately named layouts as one club/course record unless the user-facing choice requires separate playable courses.

countries.sourceName: Malaysian club affiliation and reciprocal directories (cross-reference)
countries.coverage: club-network list, not a complete national inventory
countries.notes: Cross-check with reciprocal club lists and operator pages. mScorecard may be used only as secondary discovery evidence, not as sole verification.

countries.sourceName: Ministry of Law list of golf courses (7 July 2025)
countries.coverage: 11 listed golf course sites/clubs in the 2025 annex
countries.notes: Government list is the strongest current baseline. Distinguish club/site from course layout; Serapong and Tanjong are separate selectable layouts at Sentosa.

countries.coverage: approximately 41 listed venues; not a complete national inventory
countries.notes: Use as a structured discovery source. Reconcile duplicate layouts, operator names, island/province and current operating status with official club sources.

rules: A source list is a discovery source, not proof that every listed course is currently operating.
Do not invent coordinates. Every new course begins with coordinateStatus=pending and no top-level latitude/longitude until a location is verified.
Every course must map to exactly one existing weather subregion; multiple courses may map to the same subregion.
The app catalog may contain multiple actual courses per subregion, while the climate engine continues to use one representative point per subregion.
Do not count a curated top-course list or a reciprocal-club list as a complete national inventory.
Deduplicate club names, separately selectable 9/18-hole layouts, and course aliases before enabling records.
